text:
alice: Hey team — we need to finalize ownership and a minimal schema for model/route SLO panels (P50/P95/P99, TTFT, tokens/sec). Can platform + runtime agree on emitter fields?
ben: +1. Runtime can emit, but we need clear tag set. High-cardinality tags will kill the metrics backend.
carla: From Console POV we need per-route and per-model rollups, plus the ability to filter by customer tier and region. Suggesting tags: model, route, region, tier.
devon: Also need to know cost impact for 1 week retention at daily granularity. Metrics team warned about tokens/sec histograms being heavy.
emma: Product wants to show P95 and TTFT on default dashboard and allow team to drill to P99. Keep the default card lightweight.
ben: Runtime can emit counters and latency histograms. Proposal: emit latency histogram (buckets) and a token counter + request counter. TTFT = latency for first token (we can emit first_token_latency gauge per request).
alice: That sounds good. Concrete schema idea?
ben: Example emitter payload:```
metric: llm_request_latency_histogram
labels: model,route,region,tier
value: bucketed
---
metric: llm_first_token_latency_gauge
labels: model,route,region,tier
value: ms
---
metric: llm_tokens_count_total
labels: model,route,region,tier
value: count
```
carla: Two questions: 1) Do we include quantization/variant label? 2) How do we represent routing fallback (e.g., routed to cheaper model)?
ben: For variant/quant we can add optional label "variant" but mark it low-cadence. For fallback, runtime will emit route_origin label: "primary" or "fallback". That lets Console show weighted latencies.
devon: Sampling plan: emit full histograms for 1% of requests and aggregates for the rest (percentile estimation). Metrics team prefers reservoir sampling for histograms.
emma: Product: 1% sampling might hide regressions. Can we do adaptive sampling — full histograms on error/latency spikes and baseline sampling otherwise?
ben: We can add a flag to force full emit on requests that exceed a threshold or have a model-quality alert. Needs runtime + alerting handshake.
alice: Ownership: runtime to implement emitters and sampling; eng-platform to onboard metric names and dashboards; console to build default panels and drilldowns; metrics team to approve storage budget.
carla: UX: default dashboard cards: 1) P50/P95/P99 latency (combined histogram percentile calc), 2) TTFT (P50/P95), 3) tokens/sec (rate per route), 4) error rate. Drilldown filters by model/route/region/tier/variant.
devon: On quotas: do we tag by tenant to calculate per-tenant tokens/sec quotas? That increases cardinality. Maybe we only tag by tenant for sampled streams, aggregate at route-level for enforcement.
emma: For rollouts UX we need canary overlays (comparison of new vs old model) — console needs metric pairs keyed by rollout_id label.
ben: We'll add label rollout_id optional. Runtime will annotate requests when rollout active.
alice: Action items: @ben add emitter PR with schema + sampling knobs by EOD Fri; @carla draft dashboard wireframe; @devon run cost estimate and provide storage budget; @emma define alert thresholds for TTFT and P95; @metrics-bot schedule quota review.
metrics-bot: Reminder set: quota-review meeting scheduled 2026-04-02 15:00 UTC.
carla: Quick note on aggregation: prefer precomputed percentiles in metrics backend only for default dashboard; allow on-the-fly percentile calc for drilldowns but warn about cost.
devon: Also add tags for cpu/gpu instance type for correlating infra issues.
ben: Will include instance_type label but keep it low-cardinality (region+type combined).
alice: Thanks — I'll update the RFC doc and ping infra + metrics for approvals. :thumbsup: 
carla: LGTM, will start the Console mockups and drop a link here when ready.
emma: Will draft the alert PR and link to the dashboard once mockups exist.
ben: I'll open the emitter PR after I prototype histogram sampling in staging.
alice: Closing loop: please post PR links here so we can attach to the RFC.
